3. Compounding procedures

SCHEDULE

LAWS OF MALAYSIA

FRANCHISE ACT 1998

FRANCHISE (COMPOUNDING OF OFFENCES)
REGULATIONS 1999

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 41 of the
Franchise Act 1998 [Act 590], the Minister makes the following
regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Franchise
(Compounding of Offences) Regulations 1999.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 8 October 1999.

Compoundable offences

2. All offences under the Act except for the offences under
subsection 6(2), section 37 and section 37 A, are prescribed as
compoundable offences.

Compounding procedures

3. (1) An offer to compound a compoundable offence shall be made
in Form A as specified in the Schedule.

(2) Where a person to whom is made an offer to compound a
compoundable offence accepts the offer to compound, that person shall
make payment of the compound in cash, money order, postal order or
bank draft in Form B as specified in the Schedule.

(3) If payment is made by money order, postal order or bank draft,
the money order, postal order or bank draft shall be made in the name
of the Registrar.

(4) For every payment of compound received under
subregulation (2), a receipt for the payment shall be issued to the
person to whom the offer of compound was made.

(5) The receipt for payment of compound  shall b e in Form C as
specified in the Schedule.
